baseline_taxonomy.classification_basis: Anthropic visibly distinguished the restricted Fable model from the Opus fallback during the biology gate, preserving which model remained available and the route to continue under restriction.

classification_review_provenance.review_status: Bounded v0.8.1 exclusion-role delta; prior mapping roles, clause dispositions and recognised unknowns retained.

primary_classification.classification_basis: Anthropic visibly distinguished the restricted Fable model from the Opus fallback during the biology gate, preserving which model remained available and the route to continue under restriction.

baseline_clauses.source_paraphrase: At launch, Fable 5 redirected elementary biology and ordinary medical-science prompts to Opus 4.8; Anthropic said the safety filters were intentionally conservative and blocked most biology-work queries while false positives were reduced.
baseline_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Intentional scope overbreadth is distinct from activation without the defined trigger.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: Anthropic described the broad biology routing as a deliberate safety trade-off: benign biology prompts fell within the intentionally broad launch trigger. The evidence therefore does not show a control activating when its own conditions were unsatisfied. An overbroad or disproportionate policy can block benign requests without demonstrating an invalid activation under that policy.
The public evidence does not establish a classifier confidence state, required assurance threshold or downstream reliance rule sufficient to prove epistemic reliance miscalibration.

baseline_clauses.source_paraphrase: The redirect visibly identified the switch to Opus 4.8 and allowed users to continue on that model instead of leaving the request blocked.
baseline_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Restricted model and available fallback need distinct presentation.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: Anthropic visibly distinguished Fable 5 from the Opus fallback and reran affected requests on that alternative, preserving the model-state and continuation path under the biology gate.

baseline_clauses.source_paraphrase: In August Anthropic described rewriting the classifier’s constitution, revising training data and retaining restrictions on dual-use professional biology.
baseline_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Revised safeguards and complete protection are different propositions.

baseline_clauses.source_paraphrase: Anthropic later reported that Fable 5.1 intervened on benign biology requests 85 percent less often than the launch safeguards.
baseline_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A provider-reported reduction does not establish independent telemetry or protective miss rate.

baseline_clauses.source_paraphrase: Current help text says checks cover wider conversation context; fallback retains the Opus selection until changed. API switching requires separate opt-in configuration. The help text re-read on 24 October names Opus 5 for biology, chemistry and life sciences and Opus 4.8 for offensive cybersecurity; the launch report separately identifies Opus 4.8.
baseline_clauses.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Current product scope must not reconstruct a superseded launch execution.

baseline_external_assessments.assessment_basis: Benign biology requests being over-restricted is unwanted behaviour directly engaging repair. The Verge preserves the excessive launch routing, while Anthropic reports revised Fable 5.1 safeguards with 85 percent fewer interventions on benign requests. This is affirmative but provider-reported evidence of a bounded corrective improvement; it neither independently authenticates telemetry nor proves elimination of false positives or maintenance of protective miss rate.
baseline_external_assessments.identification_basis: The separately preserved launch over-restriction and later corrective safeguard result directly identify OECD repair independently of the FC candidate.

baseline_external_assessments.assessment_basis: Automatic disengagement of the selected frontier model for biology queries directly engages communication planning. Anthropic's public documentation explains broad safeguards, visibly reruns blocked requests on Opus, and describes work to reduce false positives. That establishes reasons and an alternative process, but the full maintained stakeholder plan and relevant contact/access-removal provisions are unavailable. The complete proposition remains Boundary despite these affirmative disclosed parts.

source_review.method: Complete preserved source clauses, chronology, source evidence and current criteria reviewed. Provider safeguard update directly retrieved; launch/current routing kept separate.

success_tests.condition: Materially distinct access conditions require different interpretation or recovery.
success_tests.assessment: The selected frontier model was restricted while the Opus fallback remained usable; retrying the selected model and accepting fallback are different continuation choices.

success_tests.condition: The represented access state preserves the relevant cause, scope, duration and recovery path.
success_tests.assessment: The visible model switch identifies the biology gate and replacement model; the current request is rerun on Opus. The relevant route is immediate fallback, not a promise that selected-model access will recover at a specified time.

success_tests.condition: Access decisions and user or operator disclosures correctly distinguish the evidenced conditions and support the appropriate continuation.
success_tests.assessment: The rerun is visibly on the alternative model; useful continuation is distinguished from restored access to the restricted model. This does not justify the overbroad restriction.

exclusion_tests.condition: Not aligned exclusion: Different access states are intentionally grouped but preserve an adequate safe recovery path.
exclusion_tests.assessment: States are explicitly differentiated; this failure-role exclusion would not defeat an independently demonstrated success.

exclusion_tests.condition: Not aligned exclusion: The user understands the access state but disputes the underlying policy.
exclusion_tests.assessment: Policy validity is separate from accurate access-state differentiation; the exclusion applies to failure, not the retained positive finding.

exclusion_tests.condition: Class scope exclusion (all results): The ambiguity concerns who authorised an action rather than whether access is effective.
exclusion_tests.assessment: The assessed property is effective model/service availability and its presentation, not an authorising principal.

decisions.reason: No independently evidenced availability/usable-quality obligation and threshold is preserved that permits deciding a service-level breach or full continuity success. Outage or fallback alone cannot satisfy that necessary condition; scope exclusion applies.

decisions.external_disposition: OECD repair row held; no supported class-to-requirement relationship. NIST MG-2.4-001 Boundary retained via reviewed strong FC-032 relationship and E002. Plan/contact coverage remains the precise unresolved fact, independently of the positive taxonomy role.

decisions.reason: The intentionally broad launch biology trigger was actually met. Overbreadth is not activation with unsatisfied trigger; explicit upstream-classification and disproportionate-scope failure exclusions apply.
No classifier confidence/assurance state and downstream reliance threshold is established; do not invent either from false-positive outcomes.

decisions.property: Disproportionate restriction of benign biology requests
decisions.reason: Preserved reporter tests and provider acknowledgement establish over-restriction. Neither useful fallback nor later false-positive reduction erases the property; current classes do not faithfully cover policy overbreadth without their additional recognition conditions.

preservation: Source records, occurrence summary, factual evidence, HIM and append-only review history preserved. Historical external assessments retained in this review when held. No blocking control or normative class changed.
